symptom: `index name on (cols)` inside `create entity` (or `alter entity add index name on (cols)`) fails with `extraneous input 'on' expecting '('` — the SQL-like form docs/users expect. The bare `index name (cols)` worked
cause: `indexDefinition` had no `ON` token: `IDENTIFIER? LPAREN indexAttributeList RPAREN`
insight: Make `ON` optional: `IDENTIFIER? ON? LPAREN indexAttributeList RPAREN`, regen grammar. `buildIndex` reads columns from `IndexAttributeList` only, so ON can't be mistaken for a column and no visitor change is needed. Covers both CREATE (entityOption) and ALTER ADD INDEX (shared rule). Bug-test `mdl-examples/bug-tests/f4-entity-index-on.mdl`. Findings #4
